title: Tree
statementMd:
The Main Martian Tree grows on Mars. It is a binary tree (a rooted tree, with no more than two sons at each vertex) with $n$ vertices, where the root vertex has the number $1$. Its fruits are the Main Martian Fruits. It's summer now, so this tree does not have any fruit yet.

Autumn is coming soon, and leaves and branches will begin to fall off the tree. It is clear, that if a vertex falls off the tree, then its entire subtree will fall off too. In addition, the root will remain on the tree. Formally: the tree will have some connected subset of vertices containing the root.

After that, the fruits will grow on the tree (only at those vertices which remain). Exactly $x$ fruits will grow in the root. The number of fruits in each remaining vertex will be not less than the sum of the numbers of fruits in the remaining sons of this vertex. It is allowed, that some vertices will not have any fruits.

Natasha wondered how many tree configurations can be after the described changes. Since this number can be very large, output it modulo $998244353$.

Two configurations of the resulting tree are considered different if one of these two conditions is true:

- they have different subsets of remaining vertices;
- they have the same subset of remaining vertices, but there is a vertex in this subset where they have a different amount of fruits.

## Input

The first line contains two integers: $n$ and $x$ ($1 \le n \le 10^5$, $0 \le x \le 10^{18}$) — the size of the tree and the number of fruits in the root.

The $i$-th of the following $(n-1)$ lines contains two integers $a_i$ and $b_i$ ($1 \le a_i, b_i \le n$) — vertices connected by the $i$-th edge of the tree.

It is guaranteed that the input data describes a correct binary tree with the root at the vertex $1$.

## Output

Print one number — the number of configurations of the resulting tree modulo $998244353$.

## Note

Consider the first example. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fd2bd3c366685ee196b1a6d867140d0f9fba570d.png)

There are $2$ fruits at the vertex $1$. The following $13$ options are possible:

- there is no vertex $2$, there is no vertex $3$; ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2d84685c4b2752007cd655f87825cdb5d69fba58.png)
- there is no vertex $2$, there are no fruits at the vertex $3$; ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2489f27354899e70570fc8d6ff05014e6a68833e.png)
- there is no vertex $2$, there is $1$ fruit at the vertex $3$; ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cb214cade6521895d57d0b0843d746504f346ca8.png)
- there is no vertex $2$, there are $2$ fruits at the vertex $3$; ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/057b73ef96efcb3d1cdfb7bdc8ec0190d78acfef.png)
- there are no fruits at the vertex $2$, there is no vertex $3$; ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/910818a4edad44f602d7f61e8c1d6e70bccea20e.png)
- there are no fruits at the vertex $2$, there are no fruits at the vertex $3$; ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/efc4ddb2e31f0108b4fb1f5ef8f88a1eec350a7d.png)
- there are no fruits at the vertex $2$, there is $1$ fruit at the vertex $3$; ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b3c2ef9e06e185909ef454455c4883809a1eda4f.png)
- there are no fruits at the vertex $2$, there are $2$ fruits at the vertex $3$; ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fcaefe2970f5beb2606342a0351fbeb9957e1b6c.png)
- there is $1$ fruit at the vertex $2$, there is no vertex $3$; ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/61252552e2a5e290514dec476dcf542fc2ec4401.png)
- there is $1$ fruit at the vertex $2$, there are no fruits at the vertex $3$; ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a06867c6381a1ecf33ad4848dca79b3bd4d822d6.png)
- there is $1$ fruit at the vertex $2$, there is $1$ fruit at the vertex $3$; ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d26b0ec8a086398b6f4c8eaf3c319c29380648a2.png)
- there are $2$ fruits at the vertex $2$, there is no vertex $3$; ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/737dc971c66e8e9b7a1a3275fc4cb699e619350f.png)
- there are $2$ fruits at the vertex $2$, there are no fruits at the vertex $3$. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cabce1f357f827c248a4235d652eb7534f2eb66b.png)

Consider the second example. There are $5$ fruits at the vertex $1$. The following $7$ options are possible:

- there is no vertex $2$;
- there are no fruits at the vertex $2$;
- there is $1$ fruit at the vertex $2$;
- there are $2$ fruits at the vertex $2$;
- there are $3$ fruits at the vertex $2$;
- there are $4$ fruits at the vertex $2$;
- there are $5$ fruits at the vertex $2$.
statementZhMd:
主火星树生长在火星上。它是一棵有 $n$ 个顶点的二叉树（有根树，每个顶点至多有两个儿子），其中根顶点的编号为 $1$。它结出的果实是主火星果实。现在是夏天，因此这棵树上还没有任何果实。

秋天很快就要来了，树上的叶子和树枝将开始掉落。显然，如果一个顶点从树上掉落，那么它的整棵子树也会随之掉落。此外，根节点将始终保留在树上。形式化地说：最终树上的顶点将构成一个包含根节点的连通子集。

之后，树上将长出果实（只有那些保留下来的顶点会长出果实）。根节点上恰好会长出 $x$ 个果实。每个保留下来的顶点上的果实数不少于该顶点所有保留下来的儿子上的果实数之和。允许某些顶点上没有果实。

Natasha 想知道经过上述变化后可能得到多少种树的配置。由于这个数可能非常大，请将其对 $998244353$ 取模后输出。

如果以下两个条件之一成立，则认为得到的两棵树的配置不同：

- 它们保留下来的顶点集合不同；
- 它们保留下来的顶点集合相同，但存在一个属于该集合的顶点，在两种配置中它的果实数量不同。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数：$n$ 和 $x$（$1 \le n \le 10^5$，$0 \le x \le 10^{18}$）——树的大小以及根节点上的果实数量。

接下来的 $(n-1)$ 行中，第 $i$ 行包含两个整数 $a_i$ 和 $b_i$（$1 \le a_i, b_i \le n$）——第 $i$ 条边所连接的顶点。

保证输入数据描述了一棵以顶点 $1$ 为根的合法二叉树。

## 输出格式

输出一个数字——得到的树的配置数量对 $998244353$ 取模后的结果。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例。 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fd2bd3c366685ee196b1a6d867140d0f9fba570d.png)

顶点 $1$ 上有 $2$ 个果实。以下 $13$ 种情况都是可能的：

- 不存在顶点 $2$，不存在顶点 $3$； ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2d84685c4b2752007cd655f87825cdb5d69fba58.png)
- 不存在顶点 $2$，顶点 $3$ 上没有果实； ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2489f27354899e70570fc8d6ff05014e6a68833e.png)
- 不存在顶点 $2$，顶点 $3$ 上有 $1$ 个果实； ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cb214cade6521895d57d0b0843d746504f346ca8.png)
- 不存在顶点 $2$，顶点 $3$ 上有 $2$ 个果实； ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/057b73ef96efcb3d1cdfb7bdc8ec0190d78acfef.png)
- 顶点 $2$ 上没有果实，不存在顶点 $3$； ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/910818a4edad44f602d7f61e8c1d6e70bccea20e.png)
- 顶点 $2$ 上没有果实，顶点 $3$ 上没有果实； ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/efc4ddb2e31f0108b4fb1f5ef8f88a1eec350a7d.png)
- 顶点 $2$ 上没有果实，顶点 $3$ 上有 $1$ 个果实； ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b3c2ef9e06e185909ef454455c4883809a1eda4f.png)
- 顶点 $2$ 上没有果实，顶点 $3$ 上有 $2$ 个果实； ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fcaefe2970f5beb2606342a0351fbeb9957e1b6c.png)
- 顶点 $2$ 上有 $1$ 个果实，不存在顶点 $3$； ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/61252552e2a5e290514dec476dcf542fc2ec4401.png)
- 顶点 $2$ 上有 $1$ 个果实，顶点 $3$ 上没有果实； ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a06867c6381a1ecf33ad4848dca79b3bd4d822d6.png)
- 顶点 $2$ 上有 $1$ 个果实，顶点 $3$ 上有 $1$ 个果实； ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d26b0ec8a086398b6f4c8eaf3c319c29380648a2.png)
- 顶点 $2$ 上有 $2$ 个果实，不存在顶点 $3$； ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/737dc971c66e8e9b7a1a3275fc4cb699e619350f.png)
- 顶点 $2$ 上有 $2$ 个果实，顶点 $3$ 上没有果实。 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cabce1f357f827c248a4235d652eb7534f2eb66b.png)

考虑第二个样例。顶点 $1$ 上有 $5$ 个果实。以下 $7$ 种情况都是可能的：

- 不存在顶点 $2$；
- 顶点 $2$ 上没有果实；
- 顶点 $2$ 上有 $1$ 个果实；
- 顶点 $2$ 上有 $2$ 个果实；
- 顶点 $2$ 上有 $3$ 个果实；
- 顶点 $2$ 上有 $4$ 个果实；
- 顶点 $2$ 上有 $5$ 个果实。
